finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Until very recently, I was busy digesting a certain someone. Still not entirely done, and I won’t be for a while, but it’s getting there. With my proper return to the multiverse, I also decided to finally explore some of the places I hadn’t had a chance to visit during my isolation. Not that long ago, I entered a World Wonder called the Mycotic Depths, and from the name alone, I’m sure you would love the place,” the snake god answered.
